lines.en: Low rumble, soaring high.
Wings flap, over hills.
Dive, seeking prey.
Fly among clouds, gaze fierce.
Circle low, waiting.
Pass over grass, no trace.
High fly, survey below.
Low glide, silent.
Circling hills, patient hunt.
Wings beat, over valley.
I glide on spread wings over the Gazing Hills.
I never land, yet I still travel.
Stare distant, wait.
Gaze at ground, find target.
Circle still, watch.
Fly still, observe.
Stare sky, find prey.
Circle low, wait.
Fly quietly, no sound.
Circle quietly, wait.
Stare far, find prey.
Fly quietly, wait.

lines.zh: 我在丘陵上空转第二圈。
lines.en: I make my second circle over the hills.
The clouds push me along.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀摊平，省些力气。
lines.en: I flatten my wings to save strength.

lines.zh: 丘陵上的眼睛都朝上看。
lines.en: The eyes on the hills all turn upward.

lines.zh: 我在凝视丘陵上空转圈。
lines.en: I circle above the Gazing Hills.
Hovering, gaze locked.

lines.zh: 在凝视丘陵上空，我盘旋。
lines.en: I circle above the Gazing Hills.
Stare player, low rumble.
Lock on, low rumble.
Focus on player, ready.
Lock on, warn.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我那双眼睛正对着你。
lines.en: Look up: my eyes are already on you.
Lock on, ready strike.
Stare player, rumble.

lines.zh: 我从上面盯着你的头顶。
lines.en: I stare down at the top of your head.
You move, and my gaze follows.

lines.zh: 我的眼在水面里有倒影。
lines.en: My eye casts a reflection on the water.
That shadow on you is mine.

lines.zh: 你抬头时我已经换了位置。
lines.en: By the time you look up, I have moved.

lines.zh: 眼睛模糊了，看不清方向...
lines.en: My vision is blurring...

lines.zh: 翅膀受伤了，飞不起来了...
lines.en: My wings are hurt... I can't fly...
My wings are on fire...
Too high up...
I hit the mountain...
Sand in my eyes...
Too tired...
Wings torn...
Lightning hit me...

lines.zh: 一只眼被击中，视线歪了...
lines.en: One eye is hit and my sight slants...

lines.zh: 我那双大眼睛盯着你，你是不是也感到了？”
lines.en: My big eyes are on you, aren't you feeling it?

lines.zh: 你是否能感受到我注视的目光？
lines.en: Can you feel my gaze?

lines.zh: 我的鳞片闪闪发光，你被吸引了吗？
lines.en: My scales shine, have you been drawn in?

lines.zh: 我庞大的身躯在吸引着你吗？
lines.en: My massive form is drawing you in.

lines.zh: 你被我的眼神迷住了吗？
lines.en: Are you entranced by my gaze?
Is my flight enchanting?

lines.zh: 我的声音在呼唤你，你能听见吗？
lines.en: Can you hear my call?

lines.zh: 我这鳞片闪耀，你是不是心动了？
lines.en: My scales glitter, have you been lured?
Is your heart racing?

lines.zh: 我的呼吸都能让你心神不定吗？
lines.en: Can my breath make you restless?

lines.zh: 避开我，否则你会撞上我的！”
lines.en: Get out of my way, or you'll collide!
Watch out, don't collide!

lines.zh: 别靠近，否则我会撞上你！”
lines.en: Don't come near, or I'll collide!

lines.zh: 你敢靠近我，我会撞上你！”
lines.en: You dare to come near me, I'll collide!

lines.zh: 离我远一点，否则你会撞上我！”
lines.en: Stay away, or you'll collide!

lines.zh: 别碰我，否则你会撞上我！”
lines.en: Don't touch me, or you'll collide!
I'll collide with you when I fly!

lines.zh: 你要是不避开，就会撞上我！”
lines.en: You'll collide if you don't avoid me!

lines.zh: 你敢靠近，我就会撞上你！”
lines.en: You come near, and I'll collide!

lines.zh: 别靠近，否则你会撞上我！”
lines.en: Don't come near, or you'll collide!
Mate with me!

lines.zh: 和我交配，我会给予你力量！
lines.en: Mate with me, and I'll give you strength!

lines.zh: 在凝视丘陵上空，我绕着你飞。
lines.en: Above the Gazing Hills, I circle you in flight.

lines.zh: 来和我交配，我会让你更强！
lines.en: Mate with me, and you'll be stronger!

lines.zh: 和我交配，你会受益匪浅！
lines.en: Mate with me, you'll gain much!
Come, mate with me!
Mate with me, and I'll protect you!
Come, let's mate!
Mate with me, fly together!
Mate with me, share eternity!

lines.zh: 我从天空俯瞰大地，寻找猎物。
lines.en: I survey the land below for prey.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片反射阳光，如同宝石般闪耀。
lines.en: My scales reflect sunlight like gemstones.

lines.zh: 我能听到远处微弱的声音。
lines.en: I can hear distant whispers.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在空中划出优美弧线。
lines.en: My wings trace elegant arcs through the air.

lines.zh: 凝视丘陵是绝佳的狩猎场所。
lines.en: The gaze hills make for excellent hunting grounds.
Everything under this cloud is mine.

lines.zh: 我盯着猎物，等待出击的最佳时机。
lines.en: I fix my gaze on the prey, waiting for the perfect moment.

lines.zh: 我的火焰可以烧尽一切。
lines.en: My flames can consume all.

lines.zh: 我只需一声低吼，猎物便屈服。
lines.en: A low growl from me and the prey bows.

lines.zh: 我会在巢穴中休息，恢复力量。
lines.en: I rest in my nest, restoring my strength.

lines.zh: 我已经锁定目标，即将发动攻击。
lines.en: I have locked onto the target, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 凝视丘陵上的猎物在我视线中放大。
lines.en: The prey on the gaze hills appears to grow in my sight.

lines.zh: 我的目光如鹰般锐利，不容错过。
lines.en: My gaze is as sharp as an eagle's, unerring.
The wind is right; I dive with it.

lines.zh: 我的目光锁定在猎物身上，气息全收。
lines.en: My gaze is fixed on the prey, and I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 我将在最合适的时机发起进攻。
lines.en: I will strike at the perfect moment.

lines.zh: 我的目光中充满决绝的杀意。
lines.en: My gaze is filled with a resolve to kill.

lines.zh: 我等待猎物进入攻击范围。
lines.en: I wait for the prey to enter my range.

lines.zh: 我的视线将不会被任何事物干扰。
lines.en: My sight is unwavering.

lines.zh: 我将利用风势，发动攻击。
lines.en: I will use the wind to launch my attack.

lines.zh: 丘陵把我的视线递给你。
lines.en: The hills hand my gaze to you.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味顺着风上来。
lines.en: Your scent rises on the wind.
I have locked still above your head.

lines.zh: 别的都被我筛掉了，只剩你。
lines.en: I filtered out the rest. Only you remain.

lines.zh: 我将注视着猎物，直到它成为我的晚餐。
lines.en: I will stare down the prey until it becomes my meal.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，我的猎物将无所遁形。
lines.en: Target locked, my prey will be found.

lines.zh: 我的凝视将使猎物无法动弹。
lines.en: My gaze will paralyze the prey.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，绕到你侧后。
lines.en: I drop lower and swing behind you.

lines.zh: 我的目光中充满了对猎物的渴望。
lines.en: My gaze is filled with desire for the prey.

lines.zh: 我将紧盯着猎物，直到它露出破绽。
lines.en: I will fix my gaze on the prey until it makes a mistake.

lines.zh: 我的目光将使猎物陷入恐惧。
lines.en: My gaze will fill the prey with fear.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，我的注意力将集中于此。
lines.en: Target locked, my focus is on this.

lines.zh: 我的视线将引导我找到猎物。
lines.en: My sight will guide me to the prey.

lines.zh: 我的凝视将迫使猎物放弃抵抗。
lines.en: My gaze will force the prey to surrender.
I fold my wings and begin to drop.
I measured the wind, and I measured you.
This height is just right to fall from.

lines.zh: 我翅膀的影子先落到你脚前。
lines.en: My shadow spreads out ahead of you.
I circle around to the side behind you.
One tilt of a wing and I change course.
You run for open ground. Perfect.

lines.zh: 在凝视丘陵上空，我盘着飞。
lines.en: Above the Gazing Hills, I circle.
Look at me, feel the fear!

lines.zh: 在凝视丘陵上空，我看准了你的头。
lines.en: Circling above, I aimed for your head.
Swallow you with my eyes!
I fold my wings and drop straight onto you.
My gaze can kill you!

lines.zh: 翅膀割开你肩膀的空气。
lines.en: My wings slice the air at your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我从丘陵上扑下来抓你。
lines.en: I dive off the ridge and grab at you.

lines.zh: 我在凝视丘陵上空盘旋，别抬头。
lines.en: I circle above the Gazing Hills; do not look up.
Your world will end!
I slam down from above.
The edge of my wing rakes you.
My talons clamp onto you in midair.
I pass and a burst of dirt follows.
This is my sky!
The hills are my domain!
I roam beneath the clouds!
I am the king of the sky!
Look at me, tremble!
This sky is mine!
The hills are my territory!
I rule the sky!
My gaze is everywhere!
I fly above the hills!

lines.zh: 丘陵上方裂开一道视线。
lines.en: A seam of sight opens above the hills.
The wind lifts me over the hills.
I roll out from behind a cloud.
The eyes below are all waiting for me.
I lift off from the ground, head first.
A pair of wings joins the cloud shadow.

lines.zh: 这个高度刚好能看见全部。
lines.en: From this height I see everything.
When I arrive, the hills go quiet.
Burned by fire...
Hit the ground...

lines.zh: 掉进湖里了，翅膀浸湿了...
lines.en: Wet wings...

lines.zh: 翅膀被震歪，我在丘陵上空打转。
lines.en: My wing is knocked askew; I circle above the hills.
Shot by arrows...

lines.zh: 被魔法攻击了，眼睛受伤了...
lines.en: Magic hurt my eyes...

lines.zh: 飞了一圈，饿得眼睛都花了...
lines.en: A full lap in the air, and hunger blurs my eye...

lines.zh: 被雷劈中了，翅膀受伤了...
lines.en: Lightning struck...

lines.zh: 深渊正在吞掉我的翅膀...
lines.en: The void is swallowing my wings...
